items.question: Who was sworn in as the 53rd Chief Justice of India on 24 November 2025?
items.explanation:
**Justice Surya Kant** took oath as the 53rd CJI on 24 November 2025, succeeding Justice B. R. Gavai.

**Why not the others**
- Sanjiv Khanna — the 51st CJI (Nov 2024 - May 2025).
- B. R. Gavai — the 52nd CJI (May-Nov 2025), whom Surya Kant succeeded.
- D. Y. Chandrachud — the 50th CJI, who demitted office in November 2024.

**Key facts**
- Recent order of CJIs: Chandrachud (50th) - Khanna (51st) - Gavai (52nd) - Surya Kant (53rd).
- The CJI is appointed by the President under Article 124; convention is seniority.

*Source: Wikipedia — Chief Justice of India / The Hindu (24 Nov 2025).*

items.question:

items.question: The proposed VB-G RAM G Bill seeks to replace which existing law, and what is its headline guarantee?
options: MGNREGA; 125 days of guaranteed wage employment
MGNREGA; 150 days of guaranteed wage employment
National Food Security Act; 100 days of employment
items.explanation:
The **Viksit Bharat–Guarantee for Rozgar and Ajeevika Mission (Gramin)** Bill would replace **MGNREGA**, raising the guarantee to **125 days**.

- MGNREGA; 150 days — the guarantee is 125 days, not 150.
- National Food Security Act — a food-subsidy law, unrelated to the employment guarantee.
- PM-KISAN — an income-support scheme for farmers, not an employment guarantee.

**Key facts**
- MGNREGA guaranteed 100 days; VB-G RAM G proposes 125 days plus delayed-wage allowances.
- Wages to be paid within 7-15 days of work completion.

items.question: The National Dental Commission (NDC), constituted in March 2026, replaced which body?

items.question: Which is the correct descending order of India's civilian honours?
options: Padma Vibhushan > Bharat Ratna > Padma Bhushan > Padma Shri
Bharat Ratna > Padma Vibhushan > Padma Bhushan > Padma Shri
Bharat Ratna > Padma Bhushan > Padma Vibhushan > Padma Shri
Padma Shri > Padma Bhushan > Padma Vibhushan > Bharat Ratna

- Bharat Ratna > Padma Bhushan > Padma Vibhushan... — swaps Vibhushan and Bhushan.
- Padma Shri > ... > Bharat Ratna — fully reversed.

- No new Bharat Ratna was conferred during Nov 2025-Oct 2026.
- The 'Bharat Ratna Dr. Bhupen Hazarika National Awards' (Nov 2025) are separate cultural awards, not the Bharat Ratna itself.

items.question: The Pradhan Mantri Surya Sarovar Yojana (PM-SSY), approved by the Union Cabinet on 31 July 2026, aims to develop:
